notes: The current model tree has 19 packages; the earlier expected count of 22 was stale.
These 17 families have verified old-generated provenance: 68 concrete structs before this follow-up, 66 afterward. Every family has Core production references.
Reference counts are static, not reachability analysis. Check external Agently consumers before deleting exported types.
Conversation graph/list and Message graph contracts already alias generated types.
Mutable writer structs were authored in the original checkout. They duplicate persistence contracts but were not generated there.
Public input aliases must use generated client_input_type projections that exclude internal execution and visibility controls.
Old output envelopes often contain Status/Metrics while native outputs sometimes contain only Data. Decide the public envelope before aliasing outputs.
LowerCamel JSON is the approved policy. Exact row types can therefore alias generated types despite missing JSON tags on old copies.

message: MessageRows is flat; native MessageView adds graph relations. Generate a flat public projection.
ElicitationMessage exposes Preamble; canonical MessageView exposes Narration. Specify the public field name in DQL.
Do not borrow writer CurrentWriterView: its nullability and byte fields differ from the public reader.
payload: PayloadRowsView now aliases payload/read.PayloadRowsView with identical field names and types.
Inputs need a generated public projection; output envelope compatibility remains.
The separate reference PayloadView has byte fields, pointer timestamps and decoding hooks. It is not interchangeable with PayloadRowsView.
run: RunRows, ActiveRuns and StaleRuns match native public fields, but native RunRowsView adds four hidden maintenance fields. Generate a public projection that omits those Go fields.
RunStepsView now aliases runsteps/read.RunStepsView. Its input must exclude native visibility and internal controls.
schedule: UserCredURL differs from generated UserCredUrl; the native view also adds hidden LeaseUntilRaw.
Authored ScheduleListInput and ScheduleRunDueListInput have no Core production uses; check external callers before deletion.
scheduledrun: The relevant legacyrun/read.LegacyRun retains required string ScheduleId and matching public fields. It adds three hidden maintenance fields.
Use a generated public projection of this reader, not the broader run reader or a writer snapshot.
toolcall: ByOp and ByTurn are distinct narrower projections. Aliasing the full tool call or links view would change the output fields.
turn: Full row variants differ by native hidden CleanupStatus; a public projection can omit it.
QueuedTotal is an aggregate count. QueuedTurns is an id/queue projection. Both need their own generated shapes.
